items.title: CVE-2026-76466: Cisco TelePresence Video Communication Server (VCS) Expressway remote code execution as root in database service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the database service of Cisco Expressway Series (the Expressway-C and Expressway-E devices) lets an attacker run operating system commands as root on the underlying system. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-123890: VMware vCenter authentication bypass in directory service (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. An authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service affects VMware vCenter, as well as VMware Telco Cloud Platform and Telco Cloud Infrastructure. An attacker can exploit it remotely, without logging in, to skip authentication, which could give them full control over the affected systems.

items.title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller unauthenticated code execution in XML-RPC endpoint (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Apache Roller has a deserialization flaw in its XML-RPC endpoint that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code on the server without logging in. The endpoint deserializes vendor extension types before it checks the requester's identity.

items.title: CVE-2026-49869: Kestra code execution via auth bypass in AuthenticationFilter (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Kestra, an open-source orchestration platform, has an authentication bypass that lets an attacker create and run arbitrary workflows, giving them remote code execution as root inside the Kestra worker container. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and because the bug is listed in CISA's catalog of known exploited vulnerabilities, attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-126714: PHP remote code execution via partially written session files (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's default file-based session handler can leave a session file with a mix of new and old data if a write is interrupted, so an attacker who can influence session data may inject objects and, if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, run code on the server. The attacker can reach this remotely without logging in, though the attack depends on interrupting a write at the right moment.

items.title: CVE-2026-129496: PHP remote code execution in timezone cache (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free bug in the timezone cache of PHP (from the PHP Group), in non-thread-safe builds where a startup warning is written to a file-based error log, lets an attacker crash PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php or CGI workers. Arbitrary code execution may also be possible. The attacker can reach it remotely, without logging in, by sending a crafted request.

A flaw in the client programs component of Oracle's MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster lets an attacker read, change, create, or delete critical data that these products can access. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and no action from a user is needed.

items.title: CVE-2025-24983: Microsoft privilege escalation in Win32 kernel subsystem (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem, a core component of Microsoft Windows, contains a flaw that lets a user with local access gain higher privileges on the affected system. An attacker who already has some authorized access to the machine could exploit this to take greater control than they are permitted.

items.title: CVE-2026-22309
items.summary: The visitor tracking of JTL-Shop automatically registers unknown crawler user agents without filtering the value, and the stored value is rendered without output encoding on several pages of the administration backend (search engine statistics, crawler dashboard widget, crawler edit form, sitemap export download list and campaign details). An unauthenticated remote attacker can store script code with a single request. The code is executed in the browser session of an administrator who opens one of these pages, allowing actions to be performed with the administrator's privileges.

items.title: Buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder enables unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: CVE-2026-114938, which the researcher Calif is calling Java4Shell, is a buffer overflow in OpenJDK's Base64 decoder. The optimized decoder miscalculates the store mask for the padded tail of its input and writes past the end of the output buffer. The bug lives in the JIT-compiled fast path behind java.util.Base64.Decoder , so any application that decodes attacker-controlled Base64 can reach it. Login headers and file uploads are the obvious entry points. Two weeks later, a recording from Vanderbilt University captured a voice announcing, “You have been compromised by BYOD.” The messages took the ransom demand out of a private note and made the incident […] The post BYOD Ransomware Hackers Play Audio Ransom Messages on Computers Across Hospitals and Universities appeared first on Cyber Security News .

items.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
items.summary: A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine. The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker

items.title: AuditTeam Ransomware Gang Poses as Security Auditors and Use AV Drivers to Kill EDR Process
items.summary: A ransomware group called AuditTeam is dressing up extortion as a paid security audit. Victims get a ransom note that reads like an audit log. It asks for an “Audit & Consulting fee” in return for a report on the holes the attackers used to get in. Before the note appears, the group has already […] The post AuditTeam Ransomware Gang Poses as Security Auditors and Use AV Drivers to Kill EDR Process appeared first on Cyber Security News .

items.title: Sicherheitsvorfall - Einzelhandelsgruppe für Mode
items.summary: Am 16. November 2026 listete die Ransomware-Gruppe Rhysida eine norddeutsche Einzelhandelsgruppe für Mode auf ihrer Leak-Seite. Die Angreifer behaupten, die Server des Unternehmens vollständig kopiert zu haben. Laut den Tätern wurden 384 GB Daten in 673.267 Dateien exfiltriert. Darunter sollen sich die Buchhaltungsdatenbank, Dokumentenarchive, E-Mails und die Lohnbuchhaltungsinfrastruktur befinden. Zudem seien Ausweisdokumente der Inhaber, Informationen zu privaten Geldeinlagen und Passwörter im Klartext für Bank-, PayPal- und Händlerkonten kompromittiert worden. » Details

items.title: CVE-2026-132660: EnterpriseDB Postgres Enterprise Manager remote code execution via SECURITY DEFINER search path
items.summary: EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager has several privileged database functions that don't use a safe search path, so a user who can connect to its backend database can plant objects that the functions use in their place. Over the network with only a low-privilege login and no user interaction, an attacker can use this to run arbitrary SQL with superuser privileges.

items.summary: EnterpriseDB's Postgres Enterprise Manager gives its agent role file read and write access on the PEM server, so an attacker who controls any monitored host can read and write files on the server as the postgres operating system user. This is reachable over the network by someone with high-privilege login access, and it exposes the certificate authority key, which lets the attacker issue certif...

items.title: CVE-2026-115560: PHP remote code execution in session serializer
items.summary: PHP has a flaw where session upload progress data, when enabled, can be read back with a mismatched session serializer, letting an attacker inject objects into the application. A remote attacker who can submit a multipart upload, without logging in, could use this to run code if the application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to corrupt sessions or cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2024-21410: Microsoft Exchange privilege escalation in mail server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. Microsoft Exchange Server, the email and collaboration software used by organizations, is affected by this vulnerability. An attacker who can access the server could potentially gain higher privileges than they are authorized to have, allowing them to perform actions reserved for administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-130953 | Google Chrome up to 157.0.8103.78 Renderer improper authorization
items.summary: A vulnerability classified as critical has been found in Google Chrome . Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the component Renderer . It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-134167
items.summary: devpi-web before 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the +doc documentation route because docs_file_exists and docs_file_path in doczip.py never confine relpath to the documentation directory. Attackers can request a relpath with a leading // or percent-encoded .. segments to read server files, including the keyfs sqlite database holding password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-19030
items.summary: Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection. When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA. This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-134171
items.summary: Cesanta Mongoose 7.21 before 7.24 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rx_ip6() checksum validation that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read past received packets by sending IPv6 extension headers. Attackers can send a single IPv6 TCP or ICMPv6 packet with extension headers, causing tcp6csum_ok() and icmp6csum_ok() to use the full payload length and read adjacent receive-buffer memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-134169
items.summary: Qwik City before 1.20.3 (@builder.io/qwik-city) and @qwik.dev/router before 2.0.0-rc.4 contain an improperly controlled object modification vulnerability in formToObj that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite built-in function properties. Attackers can send a form POST with nested field names traversing inherited members of string values, breaking Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call process-wide until server restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-134164
items.summary: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an algorithmic-complexity denial of service vulnerability in lib/exif_utils.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying self-referencing EXIF IFDs. Attackers can submit a crafted 9.6 KB JPEG with repeated ExifIFD and InteropIFD pointers to block the Node.js event loop for about 23 seconds.

items.title: CVE-2026-134163
items.summary: probe-image-size 7.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in lib/common/svg_header.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to block the event loop via crafted SVG doctypes. Attackers can supply SVGs with an unclosed internal subset followed by many ']' characters to trigger quadratic backtracking in probe.sync, probe(stream) or probe(url), causing repeated event loop stalls.

items.title: CVE-2026-54045
items.summary: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/requestPasswordReset calls deleteTokens by user ID before creating a reset token, while password-reset and email-verification records in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/token.ts have no populated flow type. When password reset is enabled and email verification is enforced, an unauthenticated attacker who knows a target email can repeatedly delete pending verification tokens and prevent account verification until the unverified account expires. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-133873
items.summary: Cloud Mail before 3.6.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in attService.addAtt that allows unauthenticated attackers to store inline attachments with sender-supplied MIME types. Attackers can email SVG or HTML attachments, compute the content-hash URL under /oss/ or /attachments/, and steal session JWTs from localStorage to hijack accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-133872
items.summary: LessPass self-hosted sync server backend before commit 9469b0c lacks rate limiting on the JWT login endpoints /tokens/auth/ and /auth/jwt/create/, allowing unlimited authentication attempts. Unauthenticated remote attackers can brute force passwords or perform credential stuffing against known account emails to obtain tokens granting read and write access to stored profiles.

items.title: CVE-2026-54046
items.summary: LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, unauthenticated POST /api/user/verify requests in api/server/routes/user.js call api/server/services/AuthService.js verifyEmail and return distinct responses for unknown, verified, and unverified email addresses and the route lacks request throttling. A remote attacker can submit candidate addresses with invalid tokens to enumerate registered accounts and verification state, supporting targeted phishing or credential attacks. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-127027
items.summary: Poste.io is vulnerable to remote code execution in DMARC report processing. Email sent to dmarc-reports@ is saved without sender verification. A remote unauthenticated attacker who can send an email to the server's port 25 can execute arbitrary commands as root within the Poste.io container. This issue was fixed in version 2.5.22.

items.title: CVE-2026-129289: PHP request smuggling in FPM via unread request body (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP (PHP-FPM) can mishandle an unread HTTP request body when an application opens php://input without reading it fully. In setups where the web server reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache, a remote attacker with no login can send one crafted multipart request to forge a backend request and potentially run attacker-controlled PHP code.

items.summary: arXiv:2609.16546v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: GDDR memory in GPUs is vulnerable to Rowhammer attacks, where rapid memory accesses induce bit flips in adjacent cells, enabling data tampering and privilege escalation. items.summary: A remote, unauthenticated TLS client can make a server crash or call through a freed pointer if its snicallback assigns a different context to SSLSocket.context the documented way to select a certificate per server name and nothing else keeps the original ssl.SSLContext alive. Typical cases are servers that create an SSLContext per connection or replace it while connections are open; servers that wrap their listening socket with it are not affected. Mitigation: keep a reference to every SSLContext that sets snicallback for the lifetime of the server. TLS clients are not affected...

items.title: CVE-2026-133430
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service by terminating active sessions of arbitrary users. When processing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) documents that lack a root signature, Keycloak accepts the request as long as any assertion within the document is signed, without verifying its context or placement. An attacker holding a validly signed assertion can embed it into an unsigned logout request for another user, causing Keycloak to accept the forged request and terminate the victim's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-132661
items.summary: In Postgres Enterprise Manager (PEM), multi-factor authentication (MFA) is not enforced on the PEM web application's own routes. An attacker who knows the password of a user who has enrolled a second factor can skip the second factor and call PEM's pages and APIs directly, with that user's permissions. A similar issue in pgAdmin 4 was assigned CVE-2024-4215. From PEM 10.6.1, every authenticated PEM route requires a completed MFA check.

items.title: CVE-2026-86094
items.summary: WatchGuard Dimension records unredacted session identifiers for logged-in users in its web UI diagnostic log. A low-privileged Dimension Administrator can retrieve this log and extract a Super Administrator's session token while that administrator is logged in, enabling account takeover. This vulnerability is a secondary unmitigated attack path for CVE-2026-78174.

An attacker can reach it remotely over the network without logging in, which could let them take control of the system or crash it.

items.title: CVE-2026-101340
items.summary: Net::DNS uses a 16-bit query ID to match responses to the corresponding requests. In versions up to and including 1.57, the ID is obtained from Perl's built-in rand() function. An attacker that can observe the sequence of query IDs is able to expose the internal state of the PNRG and hence predict query IDs before they are transmitted. The victim Net::DNS instance is then exposed to forged responses injected by the attacker. Note that the deduplication cache in 1.57 has no impact on the feasibility of this attack.

items.title: CVE-2026-99684
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: hwrng: virtio - prevent use-after-free after a failed restore remove_common() frees the driver data during freeze, but does not clear vdev->priv, which points to freed memory. Also reset the device and return early from remove_common() if vdev->priv is already NULL for a safe teardown after a failed restore.

items.title: CVE-2026-99680
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark the inode preallocated for pNFS write layouts past EOF xfs_fs_map_blocks() marks the inode XFS_DIFLAG_PREALLOC only when it allocates blocks for a write layout. items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: refuse a pNFS LAYOUTCOMMIT of a range without blocks A client can commit a hole in a LAYOUTCOMMIT, because nfsd does not check the extents against its layouts. xfs_iomap_write_unwritten() then allocates written blocks there. items.title: CVE-2026-99678
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: cap the block count of xfs_iomap_write_direct() at one extent xfs_iomap_write_direct() reserves blocks for the whole count in an unsigned int. The other callers get the same mapping as before.

items.title: CVE-2026-99677
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: clamp the pNFS layout range to the maximum file size xfs_fs_map_blocks() lets two bad layout ranges through. An offset of 2^63 or more is negative and passes "offset > limit". A length above the limit, such as NFS4_UINT64_MAX, wraps "offset > limit - length" and stays unclamped. With NFS4_UINT64_MAX, a read layout is built from an uninitialized mapping. Reject a negative offset and one at the limit, and clamp the length. This needs "xfs: cap the block count of xfs_iomap_write_direct() at one extent".

An authenticated user can exploit this vulnerability to generate pre-granted permission tickets, causing Keycloak to bypass policy evaluation and issue access tokens with unauthorized scopes.

The Flex Message processing component does not adequately validate the structure of externally supplied message content. As a result, an attacker who is able to send a crafted message to a victim could cause the application to crash when the message is received or displayed. A server-side mitigation has been deployed that also protects existing iOS clients that have not been updated to version 26.19.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-133228

When a client application enforces step-up authentication or multi-factor authentication (MFA) via a minimum authentication level, Keycloak fails to apply this requirement to login sessions initiated through the credential reset endpoint. An attacker who possesses a user's initial credentials (such as a password) can navigate from the reset interface back to the standard login form and authenticate without completing the required second factor. This flaw allows an attacker to obtain valid access tokens and gain unauthorized access to protected services without sat…

items.title: CVE-2026-133225
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When processing token requests using the User-Managed Access (UMA) grant, Keycloak fails to verify whether a target client or resource server is enabled before issuing an authorization token. An authenticated remote user can exploit this flaw to obtain valid Requesting Party Tokens (RPTs) for disabled clients, bypassing administrative access controls and permissions restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133224
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When an administrator revokes tokens by setting a not-before revocation cutoff, Keycloak fails to enforce this boundary when processing User-Managed Access (UMA) grant requests using ID token claims. An authenticated remote user with an active session can submit a previously revoked ID token to receive a fresh Requesting Party Token (RPT). This flaw allows an attacker to bypass token revocation and retain unauthorized access to protected resources.

items.title: CVE-2025-71473

Attackers can supply a crafted ext4 image with an oversized s_inodes_per_group so memset writes past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing the mounting application.

items.title: CVE-2026-133528

Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

Attackers can send POST requests to /api/bars/join omitting invite_code, matching invite-disabled bars with NULL codes, to read cocktails, ingredients, members, settings and search tokens.

Attackers can supply an ext4 image with oversized s_reserved_gdt_blocks and BLOCK_UNINIT groups to write past the bitmap buffer, crashing applications that mount it.

items.title: CVE-2026-131877
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via unbounded arc length in OBJECT IDENTIFIER decoding and encoding. The content of an OBJECT IDENTIFIER or RELATIVE-OID element is passed to unpack "w*" on decode, and the arcs of an OID string to pack "w*" on encode. Perl converts each arc to or from its decimal string in time quadratic in the arc's length, and nothing limits that length. An attacker who controls the decoded data, or an OID string passed to encode, can exhaust CPU with a single oversized arc.

items.title: CVE-2026-131868
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via a declared element length passed unchecked to sysread in asn_read and asn_get. The length an element declares in its BER header is passed to sysread as the read size. Perl grows the target buffer to that size before reading, so memory is allocated from the declared length, not from the data received. A 6-byte header can declare a length of up to 4GB. A single header makes the reading process allocate the declared size. Where the allocation fails, perl exits with "Out of memory", which eval cannot catch.

items.title: CVE-2026-126956
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unlimited recursion depth in constructed-form string decoding. Any constructed-form string element causes the decoder to recurse on the element's contents. The BER encoding controls nesting depth at four bytes per level, with no bound checked. Perl recursion is heap-allocated, so the process grows without a stack crash. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust memory with a small deeply nested constructed string.

items.title: CVE-2026-126682
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via exponent-notation string in INTEGER encoding. The encoder routes any value with abs >= 2**31 to i2osp without validating that it is an integer. A string in exponent notation such as "1e8000" passes that threshold. Math::BigInt expands it to an 8001-digit integer, and i2osp's per-octet conversion loop is quadratic in that size. An attacker who controls encoded INTEGER values can exhaust CPU with a short exponent-notation string.

An inverted boolean guard ($tb || rather than $tb &&) prevents the need-more-data exit from firing once a tag byte has been decoded. When asn_decode_length returns no value because the length is absent or incomplete, no exit fires for that case either. MSG_PEEK leaves socket data unconsumed, so each re-peek returns at once while the buffer size doubles. A single t…

items.title: CVE-2026-126540
items.summary: Convert::ASN1 versions before 0.37 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via quadratic bigint loop in os2ip. Every INTEGER or ENUMERATED longer than four content octets reaches os2ip, which iterates over each content octet with $result = ($result * 256) + $octet. Each multiplication operates on a bigint that grows by one octet per step, so decoding an n-octet value takes O(n^2) bigint work. Nothing limits content length before this loop runs. An attacker who controls the decoded data can exhaust CPU with a single oversized INTEGER or ENUMERATED value.

items.title: CVE-2026-129934
items.summary: The MongoDB Go driver's connection string parser includes the raw, undecoded value of a query option in the error it returns when that value contains invalid percent encodings. When the option holds a secret, such as a TLS key file password or an AWS session token, the secret appears in plain text in the error. A party with low-privileged read access to wherever the application records or displays that error may learn the secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-129930
items.summary: A weakness in the MongoDB Node.js driver can place sensitive information taken from an application-supplied connection string into the text of an error produced while that connection string is being parsed. The error is generated inside the application process before any database connection is made, so no database account and no network access are needed for it to occur. A party able to read the application's error output or log files may thereby obtain database credentials that the application's configuration source would otherwise keep to a narrower audience.

items.title: CVE-2026-93917
items.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in WatchGuard Dimension's device management registration process allows an attacker who controls one enrolled managed device's credentials to take over another managed device's identity. This allows the attacker to receive the victim device's queued configuration and apply attacker-supplied configurations under the victim device's identity.

items.title: CVE-2026-133435
items.summary: A flaw was found in Keycloak. When configured with a database that uses case-insensitive collation, Keycloak resolves realm URLs regardless of letter casing. This issue can expose restricted authentication endpoints intended only for internal access, though Keycloak's internal authentication mechanisms remain intact.

items.title: CVE-2026-133306
items.summary: VideoLAN libaacs 0.7.0 through 0.12.0 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in aacs_resolve_path() that allows local attackers to corrupt stack memory via crafted symlinks in disc paths. items.summary: InfoScan fails to properly handle certain malformed or incomplete requests to its login and password-reset endpoints. items.title: CVE-2026-117659
items.summary: The InfoScan Electron desktop client improperly handles TLS certificate errors by accepting certificates without validating their trustworthiness. The client also configures Electron with nodeIntegration enabled, contextIsolation disabled, and webSecurity disabled. These settings weaken the client’s security boundaries. An attacker who is able to intercept or manipulate network communications may be able to present an untrusted certificate without the application rejecting the connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-129225
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. In 3.10.3 and earlier, DependencyGraph._tree and triples recurse once per dependency edge without a depth bound, and get_cycle_path also lacks a visited-set termination guard. A deeply chained or cyclic attacker-controlled CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency structure can raise RecursionError and abort a parse worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-128140
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6.7 until 3.10.4, nltk.downloader follows collection membership without tracking already visited collection nodes. A self-referencing or mutually referencing collection index can therefore make the package-closure walk loop indefinitely while its queue and memory usage grow, denying service when a victim processes the attacker-influenced index. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129230
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.max_depth, min_depth, hypernym_paths, and hypernym_distances recursively follow attacker-controlled corpus pointers without a visited-node set or depth cap. A cyclic or excessively deep hypernym graph can raise RecursionError and terminate traversal APIs and similarity operations that depend on them. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129226
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, the semantic-logic read_type parser recursively processes both halves of nested complex type strings without applying LogicParser.MAX_PARSE_DEPTH. An attacker-controlled type string or signature with excessive nesting can raise RecursionError through Type.fromstring or type-checking entry points and abort the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129222
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, DependencyGraph.tree and DependencyGraph.triples walk parsed dependency edges through unbounded Python recursion and do not use a working cycle or depth guard. A crafted CoNLL or Malt-TAB dependency file containing a sufficiently long chain can raise RecursionError when the documented traversal APIs are called, aborting the current worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-133168
items.summary: OFFIS DCMTK 3.7.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in togglePlanarConfiguration8 and togglePlanarConfiguration16 in djcodece.cc, which compute row offsets using rows instead of columns. Attackers can supply a crafted color-by-plane DICOM image with more rows than columns that is compressed with the true-lossless JPEG codec to corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-133172
items.summary: Cozy Cloud cozy-stack 1.6.62 before 1.6.69 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the shared-drive move handler that allows authenticated users to access other instances' files. Attackers owning a shared drive can name another instance's domain and any directory ID as the move source to copy and delete the victim's file tree.

items.title: CVE-2026-133169
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to inject scripts via the unsanitized products_model field. Attackers with product editing permission can store JavaScript that executes in browsers of other administrators, storefront visitors, and customers viewing carts and order history.

items.title: CVE-2026-129404
items.summary: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing SQL statement permission check in form import and field creation in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - The core.create.sql.statement permission was not enforced when importing forms or creating new fields, allowing backend users without this permission to store arbitrary SQL statements.

items.title: CVE-2026-129234
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, Prover9Parent.config_prover9 and Mace accept a relative binary_location and pass it to find_binary as path_to_bin, disabling the bare-name absolute-path guard. A local attacker who can plant prover9 or mace4 in the resolved working directory can cause subprocess.Popen to execute that binary with the invoking user's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129232
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, XMLCorpusView.read_block rebuilds the full root-to-node context path with "/".join(context) for every start tag while searching for a matching element. Deeply nested attacker-influenced corpus XML therefore causes quadratic pure-Python work and can pin a processing worker, resulting in denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129233

items.title: CVE-2026-129231
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline appends each new block to a growing character buffer and reruns splitlines over the entire buffer on every iteration. An attacker-controlled corpus file containing one very long unterminated line therefore causes quadratic CPU consumption in line-oriented corpus readers and can deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-129221
items.summary: NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, nltk.classify.weka.ARFF_Formatter writes attacker-controlled class labels into the Weka ARFF @ATTRIBUTE '-label-' declaration without safely formatting the label tokens. Crafted labels can alter the generated ARFF schema or records, corrupting classifier input and causing integrity loss or processing failure. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-83631
items.summary: On Intel-based macOS systems, the Okta Device Access (ODA) component of Okta Verify for macOS configures a LaunchDaemon service whose program path resolves via a symbolic link in /usr/local/bin. In environments where non-standard directory permissions grant local non-root users write access to this path, the symbolic link target can be modified, causing the LaunchDaemon to execute the replacement binary upon service restart.

items.title: CVE-2026-132607
items.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in the decryption component of Amazon S3 Encryption Client for PHP in AWS SDK for PHP before 3.383.1 might allow an authenticated remote user to forge ciphertext that decrypts to arbitrary plaintext via manipulation of the GCM authentication tag length metadata. items.title: CVE-2026-130236
items.summary: In the Auth0 Authorization Extension, request authentication handling can process claims from query parameters independently of header validation. Under specific preconditions, this may allow an authenticated tenant user to issue requests to the extension's administrative endpoints. Also, input handling during rule generation may permit modification of the tenant login rule published by the extension.

items.title: CVE-2026-130235
items.summary: In the Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library, outbound HTTP requests are not restricted to the configured Okta organization domain when processing certain URL formats. If a URL parameter is modified to specify an external host, the library may transmit the configured SSWS API token to that unintended destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-130233
items.summary: The Okta .NET SDK Abstractions library improperly synchronizes authentication credentials set on a shared HTTP client during request execution. When concurrent requests are dispatched for different principals, one principal's credential may be transmitted on an outbound request intended for another principal, which can result in credential exposure and lead to unauthorized actions performed as the affected principal at the Okta Management API.

items.title: CVE-2026-130153
items.summary: The Okta Client SDK for Python (okta-client-python) includes client authentication values (client_secret or JWT assertions) as query parameters in the front-channel authorization URL when executing the authorization code flow without Pushed Authorization Requests (PAR). When PAR is disabled, unsupported by the authorization server, or fails, the SDK falls back to standard authorization URL construction, transmitting these parameters via user-agent requests.

items.summary: Okta Privileged Access (OPA) Gateway includes a version of the FreeRDP library affected by memory management issues in its smartcard redirection handling. items.title: CVE-2026-69261
items.summary: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. From 0.5.0 until 3.8.1, Git LFS may forward a Cookie header after an HTTP redirect to a host other than the one for which the header was intended. That unintended host can therefore receive cookies containing credentials or other confidential values. Authorization headers are never forwarded to inappropriate hosts and are not the affected secret in this vulnerability. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-131292

items.title: CVE-2026-129933
items.summary: The MongoDB Java Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-133310

items.title: CVE-2026-133309
items.summary: @scalar/typebox before 0.1.4 contains a code injection vulnerability in TypeCompiler that allows attackers to execute JavaScript by supplying crafted schema strings. Attackers can inject single-quote breakouts into string format, Kind names, property keys or Literal values to run arbitrary JavaScript in the host Node.js process during Compile() and Check().

items.title: CVE-2026-133308
items.summary: ClassiCube before 1.4.0 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds write vulnerability in Png_Reconstruct in src/Bitmap.c that occurs when AVERAGE and PAETH filters process zero-width PNG images. A malicious multiplayer server can supply a crafted texture pack URL or player skin to write past the heap buffer, corrupting memory and crashing connecting clients.

items.title: CVE-2026-133307

A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

When a sharing group is re-captured with a newer modified timestamp and an updated roster, the application unconditionally overwrote the type, nationality, sector, and contacts fields of every organisation listed in the roster, including the host organisation. This behaviour was reachable by any user holding the perm_sync role, and additionally by any external server pulled from or any feed fetched, because those operations execute with the privileges of the site administrator who initiated them. As a result, a low-privile…

items.title: CVE-2026-99328
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: picoLCD: check for fb_deferred_io_init() error fb_deferred_io_init() allocates deferred I/O state, populating info->fbdefio_state, or leaving it NULL if an error occurs. Currently picolcd_init_framebuffer() ignores its return value. Therefore if an error arises in fb_deferred_io_init() (for instance, due to an allocation failure) info->fbdefio_state is left NULL. When the file is subsequently opened, fb_open() will dereference a NULL pointer (calling fb_deferred_io_open()). Fix this by checking for the error. Also correct…

items.title: CVE-2026-99327
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: roccat: kovaplus: reject short button reports The raw event callback runs before HID core validates and zero-pads the report. It passes the buffer to helpers which inspect data[0] and read a complete struct kovaplus_mouse_report_button for button reports. A truncated report can therefore cause an out-of-bounds read. Require enough data for the button report before calling either helper. Commit 47669bec44fe ("HID: asus: refactor the two workqueues and init sequence") added the same kind of raw-event length validation to hi…

items.title: CVE-2026-99326
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: hid-lenovo-go-s: Prevent deadlock if device removed during setup hid_gos_cfg_remove() calls a mutex before canceling delayed work. That delayed work function calls mcu_property_out(), which holds the same mutex. Prevent deadlock my removing the mutex prior to stopping the work. Additionally, since cancel_delayed_work has the potential to re-arm, switch to disable_delayed_work.

items.title: CVE-2026-99325
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: hid-lenovo-go-s: Add suspend function and gate access under bool. Currently a device can suspend while delayed work is pending or executing. Cancel delayed work if it was pending and restart it if it hasn't run yet. Gate access to show/store functions behind a bool to prevent access prior to cfg_setup() being completed.

items.title: CVE-2026-99322

The existing replay path returns the open but leaves its connection and oplock references pointing at the old channel. Its open count also stays on that channel, and a later CLOSE through the surviving channel decrements the wrong counter. Check the return value and call self.process.notify_poll(false) when PushWorkRes::OkNotifyPoll is returned. This is similar to commit 97830f3c30…

items.title: CVE-2026-133183
items.summary: MISP contains an authorization flaw in the handling of remote pull and feed operations. When a non-internal pull or a feed processes incoming data and encounters an existing sharing group, the application did not verify that the remote server's organization was actually a member of that sharing group before allowing the group's metadata to be updated. The captureRemote mechanism previously stored only a boolean flag indicating whether the link was internal, and the authorization check in captureSGExisting relied solely on that flag. For non-internal pulls and feeds, the check was insufficient:…

items.title: CVE-2026-133174
items.summary: HotGo 2.18.6 through 2.19.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated backend users to read other administrators' private letters because the messageIds helper omits the receiver filter. Low-privilege users can call GET /admin/notice/pullMessages, which is exempt from role permission checks via exceptAuth, to retrieve titles, contents and senders of private letters.

items.title: CVE-2026-133171
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 3.7.0 before 3.30.5 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in parseAttributes and parseShortcodeAttributes that allows attackers to exhaust CPU through quadratic backtracking. Attackers can supply Markdown with long crafted attribute strings parsed by createBlockMarkdownSpec, createAtomBlockMarkdownSpec or createInlineMarkdownSpec to stall browser pages or server processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133170
items.summary: Tiptap @tiptap/core 2.0.0-alpha.0 before 3.30.4 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM attributes via a __proto__ key passed to mergeAttributes(). Attackers can supply untrusted JSON attribute data whose __proto__ replaces the merged object's prototype, causing DOMSerializer.renderSpec to render injected event handlers that execute JavaScript.

items.title: CVE-2026-99406
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix lost errno returned from xfarray_foliosort LOLLM noticed that we stop the sort early but don't actually pass along the error code, which could enable repair code to continue running with an unsorted array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99405
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: abort dirtree repair if the live update hook dies LOLLM notices that if the live update hook for the directory tree repair code hits an error, it will set dl->aborted and stops working. If the repair code ever sees that condition, it ought to bail out immediately instead of continuing with obsolete data.

items.title: CVE-2026-99404
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: check fork type against dabtree block magic number LOLLM complains that we fail to flag dabtree blocks that should never be associated with the file fork -- data forks can't point to xattr leaves, and attr forks can't point to dirent blocks. Add the missing checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-99403
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: mark overfull dabtree node blocks as corrupt LOLLM observes that we need to range-check the dabtree node record count before using it to index an array. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99402
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: netfilter: nft_payload: restrict checksum offsets to known values We need to prevent userspace from corrupting e.g. tcp->doff, because many locations in conntrack and conntrack helpers rely on nf_conntrack_in() having validated the packet headers. nft_payload allows to alter headers later which invalidates this assumption. The 'Fixes' commit restricts writes to safe fields, but there is another side channel: the checksum location. Restrict this too. Reported via sashiko/gemini.

items.title: CVE-2026-133074
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz overrides web service allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to modify user and group overrides for quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to improperly alter exam access, deadlines, or testing conditions across unauthorized courses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133073
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's single view grade report web service. A missing authorization check allows authenticated students to view the names of all grade items in a course, including those configured to be hidden. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133068
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. An improper authorization check when displaying individual glossary entries allows an authenticated user to view approved glossary items from courses they do not have permission to access. This vulnerability leads to unauthorized information disclosure of restricted educational materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133067
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to missing ownership checks in badge alignments, an authenticated user with badge management privileges can view and modify alignments associated with badges they do not own. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and tampering with badge configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-133060
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle's Blackboard question import format. Insufficient validation of file paths during the question import process allows an authenticated user with permissions to import questions into a question bank to read arbitrary files accessible to the web server process. An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to view sensitive files, resulting in unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133059
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. The grade feedback web service does not properly verify group and course enrolment permissions. An authenticated user with non-editing teacher privileges can exploit this vulnerability to access grade feedback and user profile details across groups or courses they are not authorized to view, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-129927
items.summary: A credential-handling weakness in the MongoDB Python Driver allows a configuration option value that protects private key material to be written in clear text into the embedding application's own output and log records when a driver object is converted to text. A party able to read that output may obtain the credential. Obtaining it requires read access to the application's local output or log files.

A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129925
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. items.title: CVE-2026-129924
items.summary: The MongoDB Ruby driver can include unmasked connection string content in the error it raises when a connection string cannot be parsed. If that connection string carries a secret, the secret may be disclosed in cleartext through the application's error output or logs. No privileges on the driver and no network access are needed to produce the error; a party able to read the application's error output may obtain the secret.

items.title: CVE-2026-133114
items.summary: Caddy – WooCommerce Side Cart & Free Shipping Bar plugin for WordPress 3.0.0 before 3.2.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the saved-items/add REST endpoint that exposes non-public product data. Authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access can enumerate product_id values to read names, prices, images and stock status of private, draft, hidden and password-protected products.

items.title: CVE-2026-133112
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in gv_send.php because the action=process step never validates a CSRF token via check_secure_form(). Attackers can host an auto-submitting form that makes a logged-in customer send their gift voucher balance to an attacker-controlled email address for redemption.

items.title: CVE-2026-99413
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: fix buffer overruns in xfs_ioc_attr_list When we converted the al_offset array in struct xfs_attrlist into a VLA, the size of the object shrank by 4 bytes. Unfortunately, the buffer size validation in the attrlist ioctl wasn't updated to notice this, so the al_offset[0] assignment blindly writes off the end of the buffer. LOLLM noticed the omitted check and complained.

items.title: CVE-2026-99411
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: actually lock the metafile reservation when adjusting after repair LOLLM reported that xrep_reset_metafile_resv performs unlocked loads and stores to the metadata file space reservation counters and thus can race with other threads. Fix this by taking the lock.

items.title: CVE-2026-99410
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: always reset incore attr fork buffer when resetting fork LOLLM noticed that the local format attr fork verifier depends on if_bytes being set correctly. However, the fork reset function doesn't reset that correctly, which can cause post-repair verifier failures. Fix that.

items.title: CVE-2026-99409
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't fix the directory tree if live update fails LOLLM complains that we don't double-check dl->aborted one last time to before committing repairs to the filesystem. This is important because the live update handler could have set ->aborted if it encountered a runtime error.

items.title: CVE-2026-99408
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't proceed with xattr repair if the live update fails LOLLM observes that we ought to make one last check for failed live updates before replacing the xattr structure. Let's be cautious here.

items.title: CVE-2026-99407
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: xfs: don't repair fs summary counters with garbage LOLLM noticed that if we scan the filesystem and come up with totally garbage numbers for the summary counters, we don't actually mark the scan incomplete. Because we don't do this, repair can install the garbage values into the filesystem, making things worse. Don't do that.

items.title: CVE-2026-129939
items.summary: The MongoDB C Driver places a submitted connection-string option value into a diagnostic message without redaction when that option fails validation. The message is returned to the calling application and is also written to the process's standard error by the driver's default logging behavior. A party that can influence the connection string given to an application using the driver may cause that field's contents to be recorded, which may result in unintended disclosure of information the application placed in that field.

items.title: CVE-2026-129929
items.summary: The MongoDB Node.js Driver does not neutralize NUL characters in the user name and password values it places into the message it builds for SASL PLAIN authentication. A party who can choose the login values that an application passes to the driver can alter where the fields of that message begin and end. This may result in a receiving system reading a login name and secret that differ from the values the application supplied. Authenticating as a different account still requires that account's password. Only deployments that use SASL PLAIN authentication are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-129928
items.summary: The MongoDB PHP extension includes the full connection string it was given in the error it raises when that string cannot be parsed. A party able to influence any part of the connection string, including a part that holds no secret, can cause the resulting message to carry credentials into the application's standard error output and log files. This may result in unintended disclosure of authentication material to anyone able to read that output.

items.title: CVE-2026-99498
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: s390/kprobes: Prevent kprobes on instructions with exception table entry The mvcos exception handler ex_handler_ua_mvcos() decodes the faulting instruction, assuming it is an mvcos instruction. Fix this by simply preventing to set a kprobe on such instructions, similar like arm64 is doing it.

items.title: CVE-2026-87868
items.summary: MRemoteNG uses single MD5 hash with no salt and no iterations for key-derivation. An attacker who obtains the encrypted data can brute-force a weak or moderate passphrase offline at extreme speed and then decrypt every stored connection password. When the default passphrase is in use, no cracking is needed at all; the key is derived from a publicly known value. Vendor did not provide the range of vulnerable versions. Only version 1.76.20 was tested and confirmed vulnerable. Other versions may also be vulnerable.

items.title: CVE-2026-99487
items.summary: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: rust: bug: pass TAINT_WARN to warn_slowpath_fmt() on UML On UML, `warn_flags!` calls `warn_slowpath_fmt()` directly. Its third argument is a taint number, but `warn_on!` passes its bug flags there. As a result, `add_taint()` gets 2304 instead of 9 (`TAINT_WARN`). The warning is not recorded: `/proc/sys/kernel/tainted` stays 0 after `warn_on!` fires, where it should be 512. It also causes an out-of-bounds write in `add_taint()`. Pass `TAINT_WARN` directly, as C does on UML.

This issue is fixed in version 3.8.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-62258
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, the CRAM decoder validates the 254-character query-name limit only after decoding the name into a 1024-byte stack array. An attacker-controlled CRAM record can provide an overlong query name and overflow the local stack buffer before the later validation runs; all CRAM format versions are affected. Opening such a file can crash the process, corrupt stack data, and may permit arbitrary code execution. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.title: CVE-2026-62256
items.summary: HTSlib is a library for reading and writing bioinformatics file formats. Prior to 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24, fai_retrieve does not verify that the line width recorded in a FASTA .fai index is greater than or equal to the number of bases per line. When the line width is exactly one less than the base count, retrieval allocates an undersized heap buffer and writes one byte beyond its end; larger discrepancies instead cause an allocation failure that is handled. This issue can corrupt heap memory and crash the process. This issue is fixed in versions 1.21.2, 1.22.3, 1.23.2, and 1.24.

items.title: CVE-2026-133075
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient authorization checks in the quiz random question filter web service, an authenticated user with teacher privileges can modify random question settings in quizzes they do not have permission to manage. This flaw allows unauthorized users to alter assessment configurations across courses they do not oversee.

items.title: CVE-2026-133072
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient authorization checks in the quiz editing functionality allow an authenticated user with teacher privileges to view slot details and modify sections of quizzes they do not have permission to manage. An attacker could exploit this flaw to alter quiz configurations or disclose quiz structure information without proper authorization.

items.title: CVE-2026-133071
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when editing Lesson activity pages, authenticated users with teacher privileges can view and move lesson pages from courses they are not permitted to access into their own lessons. This issue can lead to unauthorized access and modification of restricted course content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133070
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to a missing authorization check when viewing and restoring wiki page versions, an authenticated user can access content from courses they are not permitted to view. This issue allows an attacker to inspect restricted course material and copy it into their own wiki pages, leading to unauthorized information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-133069
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Missing authorization checks in the forum discussion web services allow authenticated users to view discussion information in courses they do not have permission to access. In addition, users with teacher privileges may lock forum discussions in courses where they lack proper authorization. This issue can lead to unauthorized information disclosure and unauthorized discussion state modification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133066

Missing ownership verification in Feedback activity templates allows an authenticated teacher to view, use, or delete templates associated with courses other than their own. This can result in unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of course materials.

items.title: CVE-2026-133065
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Due to insufficient permission checks and input validation in the quiz question bank callback, an authenticated user can access and view questions from question banks they do not have permission to access. Furthermore, this issue allows users to trigger arbitrary class instantiation (creating unintended application objects), potentially leading to further unauthorized actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133064
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. Insufficient sanitization of objective identifiers in the SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) objectives report allows an authenticated user with content upload permissions to inject malicious scripts. When another user views the report, the injected script executes in their browser session, potentially allowing the attacker to access sensitive information or perform unauthorized actions on their behalf.

items.title: CVE-2026-133063
items.summary: A flaw was found in Moodle. items.title: CVE-2026-133062

Insufficient sanitization of data passed to queries against the external database allows an authenticated user with course editing permissions to perform a Structured Query Language (SQL) injection attack. When this non-default plugin is enabled, an attacker can exploit this issue to view, modify, or delete sensitive records within the connected external database.

items.title: phpAfterShell Explained: How Hackers Could Turn a PHP Session Flaw Into Code Execution

items.title: CVE-2026-133199 - Incorrect privilege assignment on reused e-mail addresses or group names in AWS ssosync
items.summary: Bulletin ID: 2026-194-AWS Publication Date: 11/20/2026 08:30 AM PST Description: Incorrect privilege assignment in the user and group reconciliation logic in AWS ssosync before 2.9.5 might allow an authenticated remote user who is assigned a reused Google Workspace e-mail address or group name to inherit the IAM Identity Center group memberships and permission set assignments of a previously synchronized, unrelated identity, via automatic synchronization of that Google Workspace account or group. Impacted versions: Refer to the article for the most up-to-date and complete information.

items.title: CVE-2026-133274 — CVSS 6.5
items.summary: THC-Hydra through 9.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in analyze_server_response() of hydra-http-form.c that allows malicious HTTP servers to corrupt memory via crafted Set-Cookie headers. Attackers can send a Set-Cookie header with an extra leading space followed by a repeated cookie name, causing a negative strncpy length that overflows tmpcookie and crashes Hydra.

items.title: CVE-2026-133248 — CVSS 4.8
items.summary: modified eCommerce Shopsoftware through 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows administrators with product editing permission to inject script via the products_name field. The unescaped name is rendered in the h1 heading of product detail and reviews pages, executing script in the browsers of shoppers and logged-in customers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133245 — CVSS 7.5
items.summary: parse5 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains an uncaught exception vulnerability in Preprocessor#_processSurrogate that allows remote attackers to crash applications by supplying two consecutive low surrogates. Attackers can submit input such as U+DC00 U+DC00, which decodes to out-of-range code point 0x110000 and throws a RangeError from parse, parseFragment, or streaming parsers, crashing Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-133240 — CVSS 3.1
items.summary: OpnForm before 2.8.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in PublicWebhookUrl::isPublicIp that fails to reject CGNAT, NAT64 and 6to4 address ranges. Authenticated users can configure webhook, form import or PDF image URLs resolving to these ranges to make the server send HTTPS requests to internal hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133242 — CVSS 5.4
items.summary: diaspora* before 0.10.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject script by crafting og:video:secure_url values. Attackers can post links to pages whose allowlisted-prefix video URL contains a quote and onload handler, executing script in readers' sessions when they click the video preview.

items.title: CVE-2026-133244 — CVSS 6.1
items.summary: parse5-html-rewriting-stream 7.0.0 before 8.1.1 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in RewritingStream#emitText, which skips escaping based on a stale lastStartTagName. Attackers can place entity-encoded markup after a closed script or style element to bypass RewritingStream-based filters and execute script in users' browsers.

items.title: CVE-2026-133238 — CVSS 3.1
items.summary: SABnzbd through 5.1.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the Sorter that allows attackers to write files outside the Complete folder via crafted propername, episodename or job name (%dn) values. Attackers can supply a malicious NZB with '...' sequences that collapse to '..' after single-pass replacement, moving downloaded files into arbitrary directories writable by SABnzbd.

items.title: CVE-2026-133236 — CVSS 2.7
items.summary: Modoboa before 2.13.0 contains a CRLF injection vulnerability that allows Resellers or users with domain add or change permission to inject rspamd DKIM selector map entries by supplying an unvalidated dkim_key_selector through the relay domain API. Attackers can embed a carriage return in the selector to override another tenant's domain selector, causing rspamd to sign its outgoing mail with a nonexistent selector and fail DKIM verification.

items.title: CVE-2026-133235 — CVSS 7.7
items.summary: Tandoor Recipes before 2.7.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows space admins to reach internal hosts because Nextcloud.get_client builds WebDAV clients from Storage.url without calling safe_request. Attackers can create a NEXTCLOUD storage via POST /api/storage/ pointing at internal hosts, import a file, then call GET /api/get_recipe_file/ / to read internal service or cloud metadata responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-133233 — CVSS 3.1
items.summary: Quasar before 2.35.3 contains a DOM clobbering vulnerability that allows attackers to break native wrapper detection by injecting HTML elements named Capacitor, cordova, or StatusBar. Attackers can place markup such as a div with id Capacitor into server-rendered or pre-rendered HTML so app.use(Quasar) throws and the application never mounts, or openURL() and AddressbarColor.set() throw.

items.summary: 湘南美容クリニックなどを展開するSBCメディカルグループは11月19日、データベースへの不正アクセスで162万4000人分の個人情報が取得されたと公表した。パスワードは暗号化されずに保存されていた。外部予約サービス「トリビュー」でも56院分の予約情報が不正に閲覧された。

items.title: ASUS Control Center Express、暗号鍵のハードコードでCVSS 10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われる
items.summary: ASUS Control Center Expressに暗号鍵のハードコード脆弱性。CVSS v4.0で最高値の10.0。認証なしで管理者権限を奪われ、管理下の全PCに影響が及ぶ。修正版v1.7.29への即時更新が必要になる。

items.title: Visa・Mastercard・JPMorganの顧客データ、ランサムウェアグループが公開。外部委託先が侵入経路
items.summary: ランサムウェアグループn0nが、Visa・Mastercard・JPMorgan Chaseの顧客データを公開した。カード番号の流出は確認されていない。攻撃されたのは3社の決済システムではなく、マーケティングを担う外部委託先だった。

items.title: Google、Androidアプリの開発者確認を2027年1月から全世界へ拡大。ストア外配布にも適用
items.summary: Googleが2027年1月からAndroidの開発者確認制度を全世界に広げる。Google Playだけでなく、独立系ストアやWeb経由の配布にもGoogleへの身元確認とアプリ登録が必要になる。

items.title: PHPセキュリティ更新で18件修正。FPMの接続再利用が遠隔コード実行の経路に

items.title: Frida 17.27.3 Released
items.summary: Second release of the day. QuickJS no longer needs much native stack, which matters everywhere: a hook can now run on a thread with very little stack to spare. That came out of our Barebone agent in the Linux kernel, where a mistake in a script now also becomes a JavaScript exception rather than a kernel oops, and where the agent injected into a process gained File . Decoded patterns also keep the attributes of their root type. QuickJS QuickJS has been stack-hungry. Every call from one JavaScript function to another recursed on the native stack, and so did the parser for every level of nesting…

items.title: Frida 17.27.2 Released
items.summary: A quick one with a fix for decoded patterns, and two for the Swift bindings. Patterns When decoding memory against a pattern, a field whose size can’t be worked out, because something inside it runs past the data, had none of its attributes applied. That is right for the ones that need the field’s value, but it also dropped the ones that only say how to present it: inline , hidden , sealed , name , comment and color . A view would thus draw a row for a member the author asked to have folded into its parent. Those are now kept. Swift A getter for a borrowed object made a new wrapper on every ac…

items.title: Blockchain system could secure cross-border renewable energy and carbon certificate trade
items.summary: Researchers have developed a blockchain-based system to improve the security of cross-border renewable energy trade and environmental certificates. Although associated with cryptocurrencies, it has wider applications.

items.title: Recovering from Indirect Branch Obfuscation with Hex-Rays Microcode
items.summary: This article uses samples obfuscated with the Hikari-LLVM19 framework to present a recovery method for AArch64 indirect branch obfuscation. The method is not intended to handle all indirect branches. Different obfuscators may compute target addresses in entirely different ways, so the target resolver still needs to match the specific obfuscation semantics. However, once one or two successors can be reliably identified, the subsequent CFG completion, function range expansion, and microcode rewriting steps can be reused directly.

items.title: No Straight Lines: The value of a different career journey
items.summary: There’s no single path to a successful career. Career changes, breaks and experience in different industries can build valuable qualities such as resilience, curiosity and perspective. Embracing different career journeys ultimately brings new perspectives to technology and helps create stronger, more inclusive teams.
